text.offer: It is indeed a pleasure to see you. I have watched your progress in the arcane studies with great interest; rarely have I encountered one so worthy of my tutelage. I have at last crafted an entirely new spell, grafted together from the energy fields of what the religious rabble would call Faren and Qor. I will teach you my new incantation, if you but perform one small task for me: bring me an offering to Kraanan, that I may research its mystical properties.
text.complete: It has been many moons since that last touched my lips. Return when you wish to learn the sporeburst spell, and we'll have a little toast - To the foolish masses, who offer up their feeble bodies of blood and bone to be swallowed by silent stones or jigging delusory puppet-gods.

steps.brief: Ah yes, the spell, the spell. Sporeburst! Now bring me an offering to Qor, and I shall teach you that, and more - I have recently discovered another intriguing spell as well.
